map.算法：风致水平误差系数 kw = 0.15；水平误差 = √(GPS 精度² +: Algorithm: wind horizontal-error coefficient kw = 0.15; horizontal error = sqrt(GPS accuracy^2 + (kw times wind speed)^2) (m); vertical error = sqrt(barometer^2 + (0.05 times wind speed)^2) (m); 3D combined error = sqrt(horizontal^2 + vertical^2); open-loop drift = kw times wind speed times hover duration (m). Accuracy rating: 3D error <1 m high-precision hover, <3 m normal, else rough hover.

If RTK (GPS 0.8 m) and wind 8 m/s, hover 120 s -> horizontal 1.44 m, vertical 0.50 m, 3D 1.53 m, drift 144.00 m, still normal (wind dominates). If wind drops to 1 m/s (GPS 1.5 m) -> horizontal 1.50 m, vertical 0.50 m, 3D 1.58 m, drift 9.00 m. If GPS 0.5 m and no wind -> horizontal 0.50 m, vertical 0.50 m, 3D 0.71 m, into high-precision hover.
map.开环飘移 36m 是不是太夸张？: Is 36 m open-loop drift too exaggerated?
map.这个数值反映的是「完全不修正」的极端假设：按 0.15×风速 线性累积，4m/s: This value reflects the extreme no-correction assumption: linear accumulation by 0.15 times wind speed, 4 m/s wind, 60 s gives 36 m. Real flight controllers continuously use GPS/optical-flow/vision for closed-loop position correction, so the actual drift is far smaller. The metric's meaning is to measure how large a position deviation the controller must correct each second, thus judging whether wind-resistance and control bandwidth are sufficient.
map.为什么风速对垂直误差的影响系数只有 0.05？: Why is the vertical-error wind coefficient only 0.05?
map.风主要是水平方向的，对高度通道的影响来自阵风引起的升力波动与气压扰动，量级远小于: Wind is mainly horizontal; its effect on the altitude channel comes from gust-induced lift fluctuation and pressure disturbance, far smaller than the horizontal, so 0.05 (about one third of the horizontal 0.15). This tool is a simplified model, not considering gust spectrum, ground effect and airframe aerodynamic differences.
